title: THE HEALER

video_sources.notes: Direct video source from Kibanda Vibes. HTTP status: 206 (Server: Apache).

description: A struggling man discovers he has a mysterious gift—the power to heal others. But when a young girl with a brave heart enters his life, his purpose becomes clearer than ever. Packed with emotion, laughter, and life lessons, this heartfelt story shines even brighter with VJ Junior’s smooth narration and Ugandan-style flavor that will touch your soul.
